【造型1详细描述】

【左侧中部小图】

【造型3详细描述】

entries.text:
新的怼脸拍，这Ai生成的是我的白月光啊啊啊，细粒度太丰富，提示词发评论区了

生成一段 8秒左右、9:16竖屏、4K超写实真人实拍视频。

画面中是一名明确成年东亚女性，年轻自然的东方女性面孔，脸型为小巧柔和的鹅蛋脸，脸部轮廓纤细，下颌自然收窄但不过度尖锐，整体具有非常干净、清透、邻家感的东方长相。

深棕黑色头发，中分偏自然分缝，头发向后扎成低马尾，耳侧保留少量松散碎发。一根非常明显的细长碎发从额头中央自然垂下，略微弯曲，这是人物造型的重要识别点。

自然原生眉毛，眉毛毛流清晰，不做明显眉形修饰。

深棕色大眼睛，眼球湿润，瞳孔存在真实窗户高光倒影；眼妆极淡，仅保留自然睫毛和极轻微眼部轮廓。

鼻梁纤细自然，鼻尖小巧。

嘴唇为自然粉色，使用少量透明水润唇釉，保留真实唇纹和湿润高光。

整体采用近乎素颜的清透裸妆。

皮肤白皙清透但必须保持真人质感，保留鼻翼、脸颊、眼下区域的细小皮肤纹理和自然肤色变化，不要生成塑料皮肤。

⸻

场景与光线

人物位于一个非常明亮、干净的现代室内空间。

背景为浅灰白色极简环境，靠近大型窗户。

窗外自然日光从人物侧前方进入。

整体采用：

高调自然窗光 + 柔和漫射光

没有明显人工影棚灯。

脸部阴影极浅。

眼睛内部能够看到自然窗户形成的矩形高光。

背景轻微虚化，但不能完全奶油化。

整体色调：

象牙白 + 淡粉肤色 + 黑棕头发 + 高亮自然光

⸻

0–2秒｜平静正脸

视频直接从人物正面超近距离脸部特写开始。

摄影机距离人物约 25–40cm。

使用约 50–70mm等效焦段的自然人像透视，避免手机广角导致鼻子变大。

人物整张脸几乎占据9:16画面的80%以上。

头顶可以轻微裁切。

肩膀基本不进入画面。

人物正面对着镜头。

双眼完全睁开。

安静直视摄像机。

嘴唇轻微分开。

表情没有明显情绪。

只有非常轻微的呼吸和眼球微动。

⸻

2–3.5秒｜缓慢闭眼＋抿嘴

人物开始进行第一次微表情变化。

双眼非常自然地缓慢闭合。

不是快速眨眼。

眼皮逐渐下降。

与此同时嘴唇轻轻闭合。

上下嘴唇自然抿在一起。

嘴角略微向内收。

头部产生极其轻微的侧偏。

整个动作带一点：

无奈、忍耐、轻轻叹气

的感觉。

不要夸张表演。

⸻

3.5–5.5秒｜突然委屈皱眉

人物重新睁开双眼。

随后眉毛开始明显向眉心靠拢。

眉头抬起并内收。

额头和眉心出现真实轻微皱纹。

眼睛睁大一点。

眼神瞬间变成：

委屈 + 疑惑 + 有点不开心

嘴唇恢复自然放松状态。

下唇可以略微向前。

这个阶段是整个视频最重要的表情变化。

不要做成哭泣。

不要流泪。

而是类似：

“你怎么这样看我？”

这种非常轻微的委屈表情。

⸻

5.5–7秒｜手指进入画面

人物保持皱眉和疑惑表情。

一只手从画面下方缓慢进入。

只需要出现一根食指和少量手部区域。

食指自然抬起。

慢慢靠近人物下巴和脸颊附近。

手指不要遮挡嘴巴和眼睛。

指尖最终停留在下巴侧面约几厘米的位置。

动作非常轻。

像准备指向自己的脸：

“我？”

人物同时轻微转动头部约 3–5度。

视线仍然保持在镜头附近。

⸻

7–8秒｜恢复清冷凝视

眉头逐渐放松。

皱眉消失。

眼睛恢复正常睁开状态。

人物轻微偏头。

嘴唇重新自然分开一点。

手指仍然停留在下巴附近。

最后人物用一种：

平静 + 清冷 + 略带疑问

的眼神直视镜头。

保持约0.5–1秒。

视频结束。

⸻

运镜锁定

这条视频基本不要明显运镜。

摄影机始终保持正面固定机位。

只允许存在极其轻微的真人手持呼吸感：

static close-up camera

subtle handheld micro movement

natural breathing movement

front-facing portrait

intimate facial close-up

minimal camera movement

locked facial framing

不要推镜头。

不要突然拉远。

不要环绕。

不要明显摇镜。

画面中是一名明确成年东亚女性，年轻自然的东方女性面孔，脸型为小巧柔和的鹅蛋脸，脸部轮廓纤细，下颌自然收窄但不过度尖锐，整体具有非常干净、清透、邻家感的东方长相。

自然原生眉毛，眉毛毛流清晰，不做明显眉形修饰。

深棕色大眼睛，眼球湿润，瞳孔存在真实窗户高光倒影；眼妆极淡，仅保留自然睫毛和极轻微眼部轮廓。

鼻梁纤细自然，鼻尖小巧。

嘴唇为自然粉色，使用少量透明水润唇釉，保留真实唇纹和湿润高光。

整体采用近乎素颜的清透裸妆。

皮肤白皙清透但必须保持真人质感，保留鼻翼、脸颊、眼下区域的细小皮肤纹理和自然肤色变化，不要生成塑料皮肤。

⸻

场景与光线

人物位于一个非常明亮、干净的现代室内空间。

背景为浅灰白色极简环境，靠近大型窗户。

窗外自然日光从人物侧前方进入。

整体采用：

高调自然窗光 + 柔和漫射光

没有明显人工影棚灯。

脸部阴影极浅。

眼睛内部能够看到自然窗户形成的矩形高光。

背景轻微虚化，但不能完全奶油化。

整体色调：

象牙白 + 淡粉肤色 + 黑棕头发 + 高亮自然光

⸻

0–2秒｜平静正脸

视频直接从人物正面超近距离脸部特写开始。

摄影机距离人物约 25–40cm。

使用约 50–70mm等效焦段的自然人像透视，避免手机广角导致鼻子变大。

人物整张脸几乎占据9:16画面的80%以上。

头顶可以轻微裁切。

肩膀基本不进入画面。

人物正面对着镜头。

双眼完全睁开。

安静直视摄像机。

嘴唇轻微分开。

表情没有明显情绪。

只有非常轻微的呼吸和眼球微动。

⸻

2–3.5秒｜缓慢闭眼＋抿嘴

人物开始进行第一次微表情变化。

双眼非常自然地缓慢闭合。

不是快速眨眼。

眼皮逐渐下降。

与此同时嘴唇轻轻闭合。

上下嘴唇自然抿在一起。

嘴角略微向内收。

头部产生极其轻微的侧偏。

整个动作带一点：

无奈、忍耐、轻轻叹气

的感觉。

不要夸张表演。

⸻

3.5–5.5秒｜突然委屈皱眉

人物重新睁开双眼。

随后眉毛开始明显向眉心靠拢。

眉头抬起并内收。

额头和眉心出现真实轻微皱纹。

眼睛睁大一点。

眼神瞬间变成：

委屈 + 疑惑 + 有点不开心

嘴唇恢复自然放松状态。

下唇可以略微向前。

这个阶段是整个视频最重要的表情变化。

不要做成哭泣。

不要流泪。

而是类似：

“你怎么这样看我？”

这种非常轻微的委屈表情。

⸻

5.5–7秒｜手指进入画面

人物保持皱眉和疑惑表情。

一只手从画面下方缓慢进入。

只需要出现一根食指和少量手部区域。

食指自然抬起。

慢慢靠近人物下巴和脸颊附近。

手指不要遮挡嘴巴和眼睛。

指尖最终停留在下巴侧面约几厘米的位置。

动作非常轻。

像准备指向自己的脸：

“我？”

人物同时轻微转动头部约 3–5度。

视线仍然保持在镜头附近。

⸻

7–8秒｜恢复清冷凝视

眉头逐渐放松。

皱眉消失。

眼睛恢复正常睁开状态。

人物轻微偏头。

嘴唇重新自然分开一点。

手指仍然停留在下巴附近。

最后人物用一种：

平静 + 清冷 + 略带疑问

的眼神直视镜头。

保持约0.5–1秒。

视频结束。

⸻

运镜锁定

这条视频基本不要明显运镜。

摄影机始终保持正面固定机位。

只允许存在极其轻微的真人手持呼吸感：

static close-up camera

subtle handheld micro movement

natural breathing movement

front-facing portrait

intimate facial close-up

minimal camera movement

locked facial framing

不要推镜头。

不要突然拉远。

不要环绕。

不要明显摇镜。

LEFTWARD CAMERA ORBIT
+

整个世界被冻结在参考图片这一瞬间。
成年女性模特保持参考图中的原始坐姿：
身体倚靠沙发，
双腿屈膝位于画面前景，

始终缓慢追踪正在环绕她的摄影机。
禁止眨眼。
禁止转头。
禁止嘴巴变化。
禁止面部表情变化。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【摄影机运动】
摄影机从参考图当前正前方位置开始。
随后沿着人物为中心的水平圆形轨道：
向左平行移动并连续环绕人物整整 360°。
不是人物旋转。
不是背景旋转。
不是原地 pan camera。
必须是：
physical camera dolly
+
true 3D circular orbit
+
camera traveling through physical space.
10秒内完成完整360°环绕。
平均环绕速度约：
36 degrees per second.
摄影机距离人物基本恒定，
摄影机高度基本恒定，
镜头始终朝向人物上半身 / 面部中心区域。
轨迹：
Front
→
left-front 45°
→
left profile 90°
→
left-back 135°
→
back 180°
→
right-back 225°
→
right profile 270°
→
right-front 315°
→
front 360°.
最终镜头准确回到起始机位附近，
形成完整闭环。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

摄影机从正前方开始快速但平滑地向左移动。
逐渐看到人物左侧轮廓。

继续进入人物后侧。

人物不能因为看不到正面而重新摆姿势。
保持：
同一个坐姿，
同一双腿位置，
同一个手部姿势，
同一个头部角度，
同一个发型。
摄影机到人物背后时，
自然展示参考图中无法看见的背部空间，
但必须根据现有服装、发型和身体结构进行合理连续重建。
不要突然改变发型长度。
不要改变黑色服装结构。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【5–7.5秒｜180° → 270°】
摄影机从人物背后继续向右侧环绕。
整个室内空间必须保持固定。
白色沙发、
黑白抱枕、
黑色烟囱、
墙面装饰、
地毯、
右侧黑色包袋
全部保持静止。
不能随着镜头移动重新排列。
形成非常明显的：
foreground / subject / background parallax.
人物仍然完全定格。
只有瞳孔继续追踪摄影机。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【7.5–10秒｜270° → 360°】
摄影机经过人物右侧，
继续回到正前方。
最后1秒略微减速。
最终镜头重新接近第一帧的拍摄位置。
人物姿势与第一帧保持完全一致。
最后摄影机到达正前方时，
模特的瞳孔重新看向镜头中心。
不眨眼。
画面结束。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【时间冻结规则｜最高优先级】
ABSOLUTE FREEZE.
Only the pupils and eye gaze can move.
Everything else must remain completely frozen.
NO movement of:
head
neck
shoulders
arms
hands
fingers
torso
legs
feet
hair
dress
fabric
facial muscles
eyebrows
mouth
lips
chest
breathing
background
pillows
bag
carpet
wall decoration.
The woman must behave like a perfectly frozen 3D sculpture.
Only her eyes remain alive.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【眼神机制】
眼球移动必须非常克制自然。
不要让眼睛瞬间跳动。
不要一直死盯画面中心。
眼神随着摄影机位置产生缓慢连续追踪：
camera moves left
→
pupils gradually follow camera.
camera reaches rear position
→
eye movement becomes minimal because camera is outside direct field of view.
camera comes back into peripheral vision
→
pupils gradually reconnect with camera.
camera returns front
→
eyes look directly into lens.
头部始终绝对静止。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头质感】
photorealistic live-action photography,
high-speed bullet-time photography,
realistic smartphone / full-frame camera look,
24–35mm equivalent lens,
natural indoor daylight,
real skin texture,
accurate anatomy,
stable facial identity,
physically correct perspective,
strong spatial parallax,
consistent room geometry,
continuous lighting,
no artificial cinematic relighting.
保持参考图原有：
柔和自然光，
黑白极简室内，
真实皮肤质感，
浅灰白环境，
手机私影摄影感。
不要突然增加电影灯光。
不要改变曝光。
不要改变色温。

自然原生眉毛，可以清晰看到眉毛毛流。

禁止把人物生成成传统AI美女的无瑕皮肤。

脸颊、鼻翼、鼻梁必须清楚看到：

真实毛孔
细小皮肤纹理
轻微凹凸
少量浅色雀斑
细小色素点
自然小痣
轻微肤色不均
鼻翼真实纹理
眼下细纹
皮脂产生的自然高光
面部细小绒毛

⸻

光线

使用非常强烈的自然太阳直射光。

阳光从人物面部侧前方照射，形成明显的高光和阴影分界。

鼻梁、鼻尖、颧骨、嘴唇以及额头出现真实镜面高光。

随着人物与镜头产生轻微位移，阳光被周围物体或发丝遮挡，在脸上形成不断变化的细碎光影纹理。

部分画面允许出现轻微过曝高光，这是手机近距离拍摄的重要真实感来源。

禁止影棚柔光。

禁止完美均匀打光。

⸻

0–3秒｜开场怼脸

直接从极端面部大特写开始。

摄影机距离人物面部约 10–20cm。

采用接近手机主摄或轻微长焦裁切的视觉效果。

人物面部几乎占满整个9:16画面。

镜头从略微侧面的角度拍摄，重点同时看到：

一侧眼睛
鼻梁
鼻尖
双唇
部分脸颊

人物安静看向镜头。

嘴唇微微分开。

没有说话。

只有非常轻微的呼吸。

眼球自然转动。

偶尔轻微眨眼。

摄影机出现非常轻微的手持漂移。

⸻

3–6秒｜眼睛与皮肤微距

摄影机进一步靠近人物。

画面开始进入真正的Macro Beauty Close-up。

镜头缓慢横向移动。

从眼睛移动到鼻梁，再经过脸颊。

不要快速运镜。

速度非常慢。

此时重点不是人物动作，而是展示真实皮肤。

阳光扫过脸颊后，毛孔、雀斑、细小色素点和皮肤纹理被明显照亮。

人物轻微眯眼。

眼皮自然下降。

随后缓慢重新睁开。

眼球反射出摄影设备与周围环境的自然高光。

⸻

6–10秒｜鼻子嘴唇超级特写

镜头继续缓慢向下移动。

构图逐渐变成：

鼻尖 + 鼻翼 + 上唇 + 下唇 + 单侧脸颊

占据几乎整个画面。

此时可以裁掉部分额头和眼睛。

这是原视频非常关键的构图特点：

允许五官被画面边缘切掉。

不要强迫完整脸部始终处于画面中央。

摄影机非常靠近皮肤。

清晰展示鼻翼附近的真实毛孔、脸颊细小雀斑以及皮肤表面的自然油脂。

嘴唇微微张开。

可以短暂露出一点牙齿。

嘴唇进行非常轻微的自然运动。

透明唇釉随着阳光产生湿润高光。

⸻

10–13秒｜镜头重新向眼睛移动

摄影机沿人物脸部缓慢向上移动。

从嘴唇经过鼻梁重新移动至眼睛。

人物头部轻微转动约 5–10度。

不是摆拍式转头。

而是非常自然的小幅调整。

几根黑色碎发进入镜头。

部分头发覆盖眼睛附近。

人物视线先看向镜头旁边。

随后重新看向镜头。

脸部光影发生变化。

部分区域进入阴影。

部分区域重新被阳光照亮。

⸻

13–15秒｜眼睛收尾

最后停留在人物一侧眼睛和鼻梁附近的超级近距离特写。

一只眼睛成为视觉中心。

瞳孔中具有清晰真实的环境倒影。

黑色发丝从画面上方自然垂落。

阳光穿过发丝，在眼睛周围和脸颊形成细碎的条纹状阴影。

人物最后轻微眨一次眼。

嘴角出现几乎不可察觉的自然变化。

镜头保持约1秒。

结束。

运镜锁定

整个视频不要传统意义上的“推拉摇移大运镜”，而采用 贴着人物脸部缓慢探索的微距摄影方式。

She hits the street in pink pajamas with a teddy bear and steals a whole outfit on her way to get coffee.

The socks unravel right off a girl sitting on a bench. The glasses fly straight off a stranger's face.

Made with Seedance 2.5. Full prompt below.

Prompt:
— REFERENCE DEFINITIONS —
@[Image 1]: East Asian female lead — early twenties, long black hair in a low ponytail tied with a burgundy velvet bow, clean bare-faced makeup, NO glasses, slim and tall. Opening look: pale pink small-heart-print pajama set (collared long-sleeve top and matching trousers), a brown teddy bear held in her arms. Strictly preserve her facial features, identity, features, skin tone and body proportions across every shot. Appearance and identity reference only. Reference.
silk: The transformation mechanic — fine, near-invisible spider silk. EVERY wardrobe change must play out as a complete three-stage physical process, fully on screen: (1) a strand of silk fires from @[Image 1]'s fingertips and snaps taut across the frame onto a target garment; (2) that garment unravels along the strand — the knit visibly comes apart into loose flying threads and the wearer is left in what they had underneath; (3) the threads race back along the silk line and knit themselves onto @[Image 1]'s body row by row until a finished garment closes shut. The threads are thin white filaments catching dusk light — real, physical, thread-like. NO sparkle, NO glow, NO particles, NO smoke, NO magic FX, and NO printed or graphic spiderweb motif on any finished garment. Mechanic reference only. Reference.
@[Image 2]: The lead's final styling, assembled piece by piece across the film and complete only at the end — white sleeveless ribbed knit tank with translucent mesh panelling and open cut-out shaping at the shoulders and back (a fabric structure, NOT a printed web pattern); light-blue denim pleated micro skirt with a black-and-white striped ribbed waistband, cinched with a black leather belt and square silver buckle; white over-the-knee cotton socks; black pointed-toe low kitten heels; thick black-framed glasses; hair pulled into a sleek low bun with a silver bow hairpin; black structured top-handle handbag. Wardrobe and styling detail reference only. Reference.
@[city]: Modern downtown business district sidewalk at dusk — glass curtain-wall office towers, grey paving slabs, black wrought-iron-and-timber benches, street lamps, a zebra crossing, traffic lights, white sedans gliding slowly past, a glass-walled coffee kiosk at the curb. Clean, upscale, cool city light. Every passer-by is East Asian. No brand logos or advertising signage anywhere. Location and mood reference only. Reference.
— TECHNICAL BLOCK —
High-fashion short-film quality, photoreal. 16:9 horizontal. 15s. FAST beat-synced editing — 14 distinct shots, every shot 0.7–1.3 seconds, all hard cuts on the beat, no lingering, no slow drifting camera moves. Prime lenses, shallow depth of field, alternating 85mm mid-telephoto portraiture with 35mm wide establishing shots, macro close-ups for thread detail. Cool dusk natural light, soft highlights, luminous skin, light film grain. Gimbal tracking, no handheld shake.
HARD RULES: ALL ACTION AT REAL-TIME SPEED — no slow motion, no speed ramping, no freeze frames. @[Image 1] starts with NO glasses and a ponytail with a burgundy bow; the glasses and the bun appear ONLY in the final third, woven on by silk. NEVER show a new garment layered on top of an old one — the old garment must fully unravel before the new one knits into place; no overlapping wardrobe, no floating waistbands, no half-changed layering errors. Passers-by must visibly REACT — heads snapping around, eyes widening, mouths falling open, bodies flinching. NO CGI, NO particle FX, NON-IP, no brand marks.
— PROMPT —
00:00–00:01: On the sidewalk of @[city], @[Image 1] walks in her pink heart-print pajamas with the teddy bear in her arms, ponytail and burgundy bow swinging, no glasses, side by side with an East Asian woman in a white ribbed long-sleeve top and burgundy wide-leg trousers; side-on medium shot, gimbal tracking laterally at normal walking pace.
00:01–00:02: @[Image 1]'s hand snaps up in close-up and a silk strand fires from her fingertips, whipping taut across the frame.
00:02–00:03: Macro close-up on the other woman's shoulder — the white ribbed knit catches the strand and unravels, the sleeve coming apart into loose flying threads that streak out of frame.
00:03–00:04: The threads land on @[Image 1] and knit across her chest row by row; her pink pajama top comes apart underneath and is replaced by the white knit tank, the mesh panel closing over her shoulder. The woman beside her is left in a grey ribbed tank, looking down at herself, mouth falling open in shock.
00:04–00:05: Wide 35mm establishing shot of the street and bench — an East Asian woman in an orange top and blue pleated skirt jogging past turns her head sharply as silk lines flash past her; two more women stop walking and stare.
00:05–00:06: An East Asian woman in a cream shirt and grey skirt is hit by a strand — her denim skirt unravels upward into thread and she flinches, left in her slip, hands flying to cover herself.
00:06–00:07: Low-angle lateral close-up on @[Image 1] mid-stride — her pink pajama trousers unravel away completely and, in the same motion, the denim pleats knit down her thighs, the striped waistband and silver-buckled belt cinching shut last. One continuous change, never two garments at once.
00:07–00:08: On the bench, an East Asian woman in a purple knit mini dress sits with her knees together in white over-the-knee socks and pink fuzzy slippers — a silk strand whips across frame, both socks unravel upward into thread, and she is left barefoot in the slippers, staring at her own feet.
00:08–00:09: Close-up on @[Image 1]'s legs, walking — the white threads spiral up her calves and knit into over-the-knee socks, black pointed kitten heels already on her feet, nothing else on the ground, no slippers.
00:09–00:10: An East Asian woman in a pale yellow shirt and black-framed glasses whips her head round and gasps; a strand lifts the glasses clean off her face and flicks them out of frame.
00:10–00:11: Close-up from behind — silk threads draw @[Image 1]'s black hair up, coiling it into a sleek low bun and cinching it tight, a silver bow hairpin knitting into place; the glasses settle onto her nose and she pushes them up with one finger.
00:11–00:12: Close-up on her back — the knit tank's open cut-out shaping and translucent mesh panel revealed as the last threads tighten; an East Asian woman in a navy dress passing behind her stops dead and stares.
00:12–00:13: At the glass coffee kiosk, an East Asian woman in a pink shirt hands a coffee cup out through the window; @[Image 1]'s fingers close around it and she lifts it away in one continuous motion, teddy bear in the crook of her elbow, black handbag on her arm.
00:13–00:14: Wide shot on the zebra crossing — @[Image 1] walks toward camera in the complete @[Image 2], and behind her the women she stripped stand in a row along the sidewalk in their remaining underlayers, all of them watching her.
00:14–00:15: Medium shot, @[Image 1] sips the coffee without breaking stride, gaze calm and self-possessed, walks straight past camera. Hard cut to black the instant she clears the frame.
SFX: beat-synced electronic percussion running throughout, the sharp zip and whip of silk strands firing and pulling taut, a dry tearing sound as knits unravel and a rapid clicking as threads re-knit, kitten heels on paving slabs, distant traffic, the light clack of a coffee cup lid.

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic cinematic commercial for a fictional premium sports sunglasses brand called VOLT. The film should feel like a high-end global sports campaign, combining athletic performance, stylish cinematography and dynamic camera movement.

A confident young female athlete with long dark hair wears black performance leggings, a fitted white sports top, lightweight running shoes and sleek VOLT sports sunglasses. Maintain the same woman, outfit and exact sunglasses design throughout.

She begins running along a modern city road at sunrise. Use wide shots showing her full body, front tracking shots, side tracking shots and dynamic low-angle camera movement. The sunglasses remain naturally visible without making every shot a product close-up.

She moves from the city into a mountain trail, running through changing terrain. Show wind moving through her hair and realistic sunlight reflecting from the lenses. Include brief macro shots of the sunglasses showing the lens coating, frame texture, curved design and secure fit.

The environment changes into a bright coastal road. She cycles and then runs along the waterfront under intense sunlight. The camera moves alongside her while the sunglasses protect her eyes from glare.

Suddenly, light rain begins. She continues running confidently through the wet trail. Use slow-motion shots of rain droplets hitting the sunglasses and water rolling across the lenses while maintaining clear visibility.

Finish with her stopping on a mountain overlook at golden hour. She looks toward the horizon as the camera slowly moves from her face into an extreme cinematic close-up of the sunglasses, capturing the sunset reflected across the lenses.

Voiceover throughout:
“Move faster. See clearer. Stay focused. Built for bright days, changing conditions and every challenge ahead. VOLT sports sunglasses. See the motion.”

Audio: Energetic cinematic soundtrack, realistic footsteps, wind, breathing, cycling sounds, rain and subtle lens/gear sounds. Build the music as her journey becomes more intense.

entries.text:
Create a ultra-realistic cinematic fashion video using the uploaded images as exact visual references for the woman, crowd, wardrobe, framing, and atmosphere.
A young woman with the same short dark bob wears a fitted black turtleneck, black trousers, and black shoes, standing confidently at the center of a large crowd.
Start with her walking slowly toward the middle of the crowd, calm and expressionless, with a lit cigarette naturally held between her lips.
She reaches the center, stops, and faces directly into the camera.
She takes one slow drag from the cigarette, then removes it from her mouth.
She slowly exhales a visible stream of smoke toward the camera, with the smoke naturally drifting across her face.
She lowers her hand and becomes completely still, staring directly into the lens.
The entire crowd behind her remains frozen for a brief moment.
Suddenly, everyone behind her begins moving in perfect synchronization — sharp head turns, shoulder jerks, folding forward and snapping upright.
The movement should feel rhythmic, strange, powerful, and physically realistic.
The woman does not move at all while the entire crowd moves behind her.
Slowly push the camera closer to her, keeping her sharply focused while the crowd has subtle depth-of-field blur.
Dark, cold, mysterious lighting with deep shadows, realistic skin, hair, clothing, cigarette ember, and physically accurate smoke.
